description: This file defines Express.js route handlers related to user session management, including listing tenants, setting active tenants, and toggling administrative modes. It handles authentication, authorization, auditing, and setting cookies for tenant context.

methods.name: GET /api/session/tenants
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list tenants accessible to the current user, with audit logging.

methods.name: POST /api/session/tenant
methods.description: Handles POST request to set a specific tenant as active in the session, with RBAC validation and audit logging.

methods.name: POST /api/session/tenants/select
methods.description: Alias route to select an active tenant, internally reroutes to /tenant handler.

methods.name: POST /api/session/all-tenants
methods.description: Allows a super admin to toggle global tenant filter mode for the session/request, with audit logging.
